sources.title: amazon-science/chronos-forecasting | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The architecture follows a layered design where user-facing methods delegate to model-specific pipeline implementations. Each pipeline (ChronosPipeline, ChronosBoltPipeline, Chronos2Pipeline) inherits from BaseChronosPipeline and manages its corresponding model, configuration, and transformation logic.
